sections.title: Summary
sections.text: The model scores this case positive with probability 100.0% (logit 19.86).

sections.title: Evidence
sections.text: The strongest contributions come from patches 1146, 1198, 1197. Patch 1146 alone adds 2.64 to the logit.

sections.title: What-if
sections.text: Removing the top 5 patches changes the probability from 100.0% to 99.7%.

sections.title: Limits
